subject: Re: demo - real workspace
text:
Hi Sara,

Thanks for your reply.

We are looking to annotate boxing matches. We have the bounding boxes but
we will want to categorize the bounding boxes (boxer vs referee etc...) and
we will want to annotate events (punch, movement, etc...) and assign these
events to the individual boxers. The short of it is we want to say who did
what when and where. I don't know if you support hierarchical annotations
or what is your recommended way to assign different classifications to the
same entity.

We are building up the team of annotators which would be in the dozen. I
will be the admin and I am currently evaluating different video annotation
platforms to see
1. which can get us the annotations we need
2. given the platform has the right features, can I learn how to use it and
then show the annotators?
3. can I manage the annotators coming in and out of the project? how do I
track their progress?

We are expecting to annotate about 10 hours for an upcoming MVP, and then
if the MVP is successful, this will be extended to hundreds of hours and
then to other sports such as judo and swimming.

In the immediate, I was just trying to see if I could test it on a short
video I have.

Best,
